behaviors_asserted: basePath is currently configured on a Hono app without a context.
Allow configuring the base path for routing using information from the context.
basePath should accept a function that receives the context and returns the base path (e.g., c => c.req.header('X-BASE-PATH')).
Routes defined on the app should be available under the computed base path (e.g., GET /apps/myapp1/book for base path /apps/myapp1 and route '/book').
